import { DocsAgentIndex } from '@/components/docs/docs-agent-index';
import { Callout } from '@/components/docs/docs-callout';

<DocsAgentIndex />

**π-SPI** is the BCEAO instant account-to-account rail for the UEMOA. Currency is **XOF**. In the API the identifier stays `SPI`.

<Callout type="warn">
  **Not available.** lomi. is not a PI-SPI participant and does not offer π-SPI collection or payouts.
</Callout>

## Countries

The rail covers these UEMOA members. That is the rail's geography, not lomi. availability.

| Code | Country |
| --- | --- |
| BJ | Benin |
| BF | Burkina Faso |
| CI | Côte d'Ivoire |
| GW | Guinea-Bissau |
| ML | Mali |
| NE | Niger |
| SN | Senegal |
| TG | Togo |
